name: Prophet of the Covenant
text: When a friendly Faction model in this model's CTRL attacks an enemy that is burning in melee, it may put the fire out to boost that attack roll or that damage roll.

name: Prophet of the Covenant (attack)
text: Granted: against a burning enemy, put its fire out to boost a melee attack roll (never a roll already boosted). Used on the attack only when the hit is a long shot; otherwise the fire is kept for damage.

name: Prophet of the Covenant (damage)
text: Granted: against a burning enemy, put its fire out to boost a melee damage roll (never a roll already boosted).

name: Illumination
text: Once per turn in her activation she may put out the fire on an enemy in her CTRL to cast one spell without paying its focus.

name: Marshal [Covenant of the Flame]
text: Friendly Covenant of the Flame models never block this model's line of sight, and it may advance through them when it has the movement to get fully past.

name: Critical Fire
text: A critical hit sets the target on fire.

name: Continuous Effect: Fire
text: A hit sets the target on fire.

name: Chain Weapon
text: This weapon wraps around shields: Buckler, Shield and the Shield Wall ARM bonus give the target nothing against it.

name: Thresher
text: Special attack: one swing at every model, friend or foe, in its melee range and line of sight, all resolved at once.
verify: Not offered yet: needs a sweep attack in core (menoth.md New mechanics).

name: Heavy Boiler
text: Its run is 2 inches longer than other warjacks of its speed.
verify: Needs core: +2 SPD only while running.

name: Sanctified Hull
text: While inside its Leader's CTRL, models within 3 inches of it share the Gift of Menoth chosen this round.
verify: The Four Gifts of Menoth are not built yet, so this does nothing.

name: Gladiator
text: Venerable head: +2 on its power attack damage rolls and their collateral damage rolls.

name: Set Defense
text: Charge attack rolls and slam power attack rolls against this model take -2.

name: Combined Melee Attack
text: Models of this unit in melee range may combine their attacks: one makes the attack and each extra participant adds +1 to its attack and damage rolls.

name: Shield Guard
text: Once per round, when a friendly model within 3 inches is hit directly by a ranged attack that is not a spray, this model may take the hit in its place, suffering every damage roll and effect. Not while knocked down or stationary.
verify: Needs core: redirect a direct ranged hit.

name: Heroic Inspiration [Flameguard Defender]
text: A friendly Flameguard Defender attacking in melee an enemy that stands in this model's melee range rolls one extra damage die.
verify: Needs a plugin: extra damage die for Defenders near him.

name: Marshal [Flameguard Defender]
text: Friendly Flameguard Defenders never block this model's line of sight, and it may advance through them when it has the movement to get fully past.

name: Holy Martyrs [Flameguard Defender]
text: When an enemy attack would disable this model, a friendly Flameguard Defender within 5 inches may die in its place; this model then heals 1 box.
verify: Needs core: substitute death at death.disabled.

name: Cleansing Volley
text: Once per turn in its combat action, after a ranged attack hits a burning enemy directly, it may put that fire out to shoot once more at once.
verify: Core does not run removeCondition or addAttack here yet, so the extra shot is not made.

name: Reconnaissance
text: Special action: a friendly warrior model within 8 inches gains Pathfinder for one turn.
verify: The card also allows a whole unit; core grants it to the model picked.

name: Armor-Piercing Arrow
text: Arrow choice: this shot drops to POW 8, but the target's base ARM is halved for its damage.
verify: Core keeps the bow at POW 12 for this arrow (no POW override yet).

name: Featherweight Arrow
text: Arrow choice: loose two shots at once, each at a different enemy.
verify: Core makes one shot only (needs two simultaneous attacks).

name: Incendiary Arrow
text: Arrow choice: the shot bursts as a small blast (AOE 2, POW 12) of fire, and models it hits catch fire.
verify: blastShot gives AOE 2 at POW 12 direct and 6 blast; the card leaves the blast POW blank in our source. Fire damage type not applied.

name: Incendiary Arrow (fire)
text: With the incendiary arrow, the model hit catches fire.

name: The Four Gifts of Menoth
text: Each Maintenance Phase the Leader takes one Gift for the round: Flame (enemy warriors cannot charge or special attack friendly Faction models in its CTRL), Law (no enemy spells at them), Sheaf (enemy cohorts in its CTRL cannot use focus, essence or be forced) or Wall (no enemy ranged attacks at them); no repeat until all four are used.
verify: Not built: needs a maintenance-phase choice and targeting bans in core.
